meta.name: Belanou Combined Cycle Power Project (Case P)
meta.author: Case Bible designer
meta.status_note: Assumptions only. Model outputs (debt quantum, IDC, fees in USD, ratios, IRRs, valuations) are computed by the reference model and recorded in the figure ledger. Where this file and case-bible.md disagree, raise a change request; do not silently pick one.

periodicity.construction: monthly, Month 1 = August 2018 (notice to proceed 2018-08-01); financial close 2018-07-17 is treated as occurring at the start of Month 1
periodicity.operations: semiannual, periods ending 30 June and 31 December; first operating period is a stub from COD to the next period end
periodicity.day_count: ACT/360 for all USD floating-rate loans and the swap floating leg; 30/360 for the swap fixed leg and the 2025 bond; ACT/365 for KCR items and shareholder loans
periodicity.indexation_dates: tariff indices reset 1 January and 1 July using index values lagged 3 months (September and March readings)

meta.units_convention: Key names carry units: _usd_m = USD millions; _usd = USD; _kcr_m = KCR millions; _pct = percent (5.0 means 5.0%); _x = ratio multiple; _mw, _gwh, _mwh, _kj_per_kwh, _mmbtu, _days, _months, _years. Prices labelled _2016 or _2018 are in prices of the stated base date before indexation.
meta.sign_convention: Costs stored as positive numbers; subtracted explicitly (style sheet 2.7).

macro.notes: US CPI-U annual averages 2015-2025 approximate published values (fact-check against BLS before printing); 2026+ assumptions. Kessara series are fictional. FX quoted as KCR per USD.
macro.index_construction_rule: Build monthly index levels by spreading each calendar year's average change evenly across its months (geometric); set both indices = 100.0 at November 2016 (bid base date). Tariff uses the index value of the month 3 months before each reset date.

fx_kcr_per_usd.projection_rule_after_2026H2: Depreciate at the inflation differential: FX_t = FX_(t-1) x (1 + Kessara CPI)/(1 + US CPI), applied semiannually with half-year rates.

usd_base_rates.notes: Fixings at the start of each semiannual interest period. 6M USD LIBOR applies to loans through 2022-12-31; 6M CME Term SOFR plus the ISDA 6M spread adjustment from 2023-01-01. Historical values approximate; fact-check before printing exact figures.
usd_base_rates.construction_monthly_rule: During construction each month accrues at the 6M LIBOR fixed for the semiannual period containing that month.
usd_base_rates.base_case_at_close_forward_curve_note: The FC base case (scenario 'FC_base') uses the forward 6M LIBOR curve as at financial close: 2018H2 2.52, 2019H1 2.79, 2019H2 2.94, 2020H1 3.02, 2020H2 3.06, 2021 3.09, 2022 3.11, 2023-2034 3.12 (flat). Swapped portion is unaffected.

plant.configuration: 2x1 combined cycle: two F-class gas turbines (Bergmark BT-9F), two triple-pressure reheat HRSGs, one reheat condensing steam turbine; once-through seawater cooling; dual fuel not provided (gas only)

degradation.note: Model uses a smooth average: output factor = (1 - 0.0015 x years since COD) x (1 - 0.010); heat-rate factor = (1 + 0.0012 x years since COD) x (1 + 0.008).

availability_profile_pct_by_operating_ye.note: OY4 hot gas path; OY8 major inspection plus steam turbine major overhaul; cycle repeats from OY9. Includes forced outage rate 3.0%.

plant.auxiliary_load_note: Net figures already net of auxiliary load; no separate adjustment

computed_by_model: shareholder loan interest capitalized (not a funded use)

profiles.owners_costs_actual_rule: Base owner's costs follow the base profile over Months 1-33; the extension costs listed under events.construction_overrun are spread evenly over Months 34-40.
profiles.lenders_advisors_timing: 70% at FC, remainder evenly Months 2-33 (base) or 2-40 (actual)
profiles.contingency_timing_base: Drawn pro rata with EPC progress payments (FC base case assumes full use, per lender practice)
profiles.lntp_note: LNTP payment of USD 14.20m (Feb 2018) was funded by sponsors before FC and is part of the EPC price; it is credited as an equity contribution at FC and reduces the Month 1 EPC advance accordingly.

ppa.structure: BOOT; plant transfers to SEKA at expiry for USD 1 subject to handback conditions
ppa.currency: Tariff denominated in USD, invoiced monthly in USD, paid in KCR at the Central Bank mid rate on the business day before payment

capacity_charge_usd_per_kw_month_2016.local_share_mechanics: Local share converted to KCR at bid base rate 462.35, indexed by Kessara CPI, reconverted to USD at the invoice-date FX rate

ppa.fuel_charge: Net energy delivered (MWh) x contracted heat rate at the dispatched load (kJ/kWh LHV) x 1.108 / 1,055,056 x gas price (USD/MMBtu, GCV) from the GSA; plus pass-through of GTA reservation and commodity charges and of GSA take-or-pay payments caused by SEKA dispatch
ppa.capacity_payment_rule: Capacity payment = capacity charge x contracted capacity x min(1, availability / 90%). No bonus above target.

payment_security.standby_lc: Issued for SEKA by Union Bancaire du Kessara, confirmed by Castellan Bank; amount = 2 months of estimated capacity charges + 1 month of estimated energy charges; USD 33.8m in 2022
payment_security.government_guarantee: Ministry of Economy and Finance guarantee of SEKA payment obligations and termination amounts (Garantie de l'Etat), capped at USD 1,250m
payment_security.abdb_prg_note: PRG backs the LC confirming bank's reimbursement claim against the Republic; fee subsidised by a donor facility

termination_compensation.seka_or_government_default_and_political: senior debt outstanding + swap breakage + equity amount, where equity amount = greater of (a) NPV of projected distributions at 14.5% and (b) equity contributed compounded at 14.5% less distributions received
termination_compensation.project_company_default: 100% of senior debt outstanding (principal plus accrued interest at the non-default rate, excluding default interest and swap breakage beyond scheduled hedges), less insurance proceeds
termination_compensation.natural_fm_beyond_180_days: senior debt outstanding + equity contributed less distributions (no return)

ppa.dispatch: SEKA dispatches in merit order through the national control center; minimum stable load 45% per GT block; start charges included in VOM
ppa.change_in_law: Kessaran change in law affecting costs > USD 0.5m p.a. passed through; change in tax law affecting dividend WHT excluded
ppa.refinancing_gain_sharing: None; SEKA consent needed only if the refinancing extends beyond PPA term or increases termination exposure

bid_evaluation.method: levelized tariff over 25 years at 10.0% USD discount rate, 70% dispatch, reference gas price USD 5.50/MMBtu flat, contracted heat rate

gsa.seller: Societe Nationale des Hydrocarbures du Kessara (SNHK), as aggregator from the Sombe West offshore field
gsa.acq_rule: DCQ x days in contract year
gsa.deliver_or_pay: Seller shortfall below 95% of nominations: price discount 25% on shortfall quantities plus SEKA deemed availability under PPA
gsa.payment_terms: 30 days after month end, in KCR at Central Bank mid rate

gta.note: All GTA charges pass through to SEKA under the PPA fuel transportation pass-through

opex.om_availability_incentive: +/- USD 0.60m p.a. (2018 USD) linear between 89% and 95% availability, zero at 92%
opex.insurance_indexation: US CPI; plus market step-up of 18.0% from 2022H2 (hard market)
opex.decommissioning_handback_reserve: Handback reserve funded from OY20: USD 1.85m p.a. (2018 USD, US CPI) to PPA expiry

working_capital.note: Receivable days in the crisis case are replaced by the arrears path in events.offtaker_crisis

depreciation.capitalized_items: all construction uses including IDC, fees, ECA premium, development fee; DSRA funding and working capital excluded
depreciation.deferred_depreciation_during_holiday: Depreciation for holiday years is deemed deferred (amortissements reputes differes) and deductible later without time limit

tax.shareholder_loan_interest_deductibility: Deductible; thin cap 3:1 related-party debt to equity; rate cap Kessara policy rate + 3% does not bind for USD loans (USD loans exempt)
tax.third_party_interest_limitation: 30% of tax EBITDA from 1 January 2025 under Finance Act 2024; loans signed before 1 January 2023 grandfathered, including refinancing that does not increase principal

withholding_tax_pct.interest_gross_up_by_project_company: commercial bank tranche and standby facility (commercial portion)

tax.indirect_transfer_tax_note: Finance Act 2024: gains on offshore share transfers deriving >50% of value from Kessaran assets, effective 1 January 2025

sponsors_and_equity.shareholder_loan_terms: USD; interest capitalized until COD, then paid subordinated to senior debt service and reserves; repaid from distributable cash after interest
sponsors_and_equity.equity_funding_mode: pro rata 25:75 with senior debt, each sponsor's undrawn commitment backed by LCs from banks rated A- or better (Groupe Talme LC issued by Union Bancaire du Kessara, confirmed by Kaito Pacific Bank)

sizing.downside_definition: banking dispatch replaced by availability 6.5 points below profile every year, heat rate +1.5%, fixed opex +10%
sizing.sculpting: Aggregate senior debt service sculpted to base-case CFADS / 1.35 each period from first repayment to final maturity; quantum = min(DSCR-sculpted PV, gearing cap). All tranches amortize pro rata on the common sculpted profile.
sizing.eca_constraints: OECD Arrangement project finance terms: repayment term from starting point (COD) <= 14 years; weighted average life of repayment <= 7.25 years; first repayment no later than 6 months after starting point (base case); no single installment > 25% of principal. Modeler must test and report.
sizing.expected_binding_constraint: gearing cap or close to it (both within 3%)

eca_covered.lenders: Castellan Bank (ECA agent), Kaito Pacific Bank, Banque Raveau
eca_covered.premium_payment: upfront pro rata to each drawdown, financed

commercial_uncovered.lenders: Castellan Bank (MLA, bookrunner, modeling bank, hedge coordinator) 34%, Banque Raveau (MLA, documentation) 26%, Kaito Pacific Bank (MLA, technical) 22%, Hovland Bank ASA (MLA, insurance) 18%
commercial_uncovered.soft_mini_perm: from 2027-01-01, 50% of cash otherwise distributable is swept to prepay this tranche

standby_facility.draw_rule: after contingency exhausted, drawn 75:25 with contingent equity
standby_facility.repayment: pro rata with senior debt from first repayment date

common_terms.cash_sweep_base: none except soft mini-perm sweep and lock-up cash after 2 consecutive lock-ups

covenants.historic_dscr_test: 12 months to each test date, cash basis
covenants.equity_cure: permitted twice over life, not consecutive, by shareholder loan to raise CFADS for the test period

reserves.dsra_funding: fully funded at COD from final debt and equity drawdown
reserves.dsra_lc_substitution: permitted for sponsors with A- rated LC
reserves.mmra: Accumulate in each of the 6 semiannual periods before a major outage one sixth of the projected cost of the steam turbine/BOP overhaul and HRSG/BOP minor works (costs outside LTSA)

interest_rate_swap.fixed_rate_composition: mid-market 2.872% + 7.5 bp credit and execution charge
interest_rate_swap.notional_profile: 80% of projected outstanding ECA, A-loan, B-loan, commercial tranche balances in the FC base case, accreting during construction, amortizing to 2034-06-30
interest_rate_swap.counterparties: Castellan Bank, Banque Raveau, Kaito Pacific Bank, Hovland Bank ASA pro rata to commercial tranche shares
interest_rate_swap.libor_transition: ISDA 2020 IBOR Fallbacks Protocol: from the first reset after 2023-06-30 the floating leg pays compounded SOFR in arrears + 0.42826%. Model simplification: treat swap floating leg as equal to the loan base rate each period (LIBOR through 2022, Term SOFR + CAS from 2023); basis H1 2023 ignored.
interest_rate_swap.unwind_on_refinancing: Portion of notional attributable to prepaid tranches (commercial + B-loan) terminated 2025-06-30 at mark-to-market using a flat swap rate of 3.68% for the remaining profile

hedging.fx: No FX hedge on revenue (USD-indexed tariff). No hedge on KCR costs. Offshore USD accounts with Castellan Bank London under Central Bank Exchange Control Authorization 2018-114.

onshore: KCR Collection Account (Union Bancaire du Kessara)
accounts.sweep_rule: KCR collections converted and swept offshore daily, subject to Central Bank FX availability

insurance_program.political_risk_insurance: Private-market PRI for the commercial tranche: 90% of principal and interest, covering expropriation, currency inconvertibility and transfer, political violence, and non-honoring of the government guarantee; premium 1.15% p.a. on insured amount, paid by project company
insurance_program.local_fronting_insurer: Assurances Generales du Kessara (AGK), 95% reinsured offshore with cut-through and assignment of reinsurance

epc_terms.contractor: Lindauer Kraftwerksbau AG (leader, 82%) and Bati-Kessara SA (civil works, 18%), joint and several
epc_terms.price_basis: lump-sum turnkey, date-certain, fixed price; onshore portion fixed in KCR at 519.4 KCR/USD
epc_terms.completion_tests: net output and heat rate corrected to reference conditions; 720-hour reliability run with >= 95% availability; emissions and grid code compliance

plus_computed_by_model: additional IDC and commitment fees from 7-month delay
funding_order: standby facility and contingent equity drawn 75:25 (pro rata) for the remainder
construction_overrun.performance_ld_application: 100% mandatory prepayment of senior debt pro rata on 2022-06-30

offtaker_crisis.path_note: Overdue amounts in excess of normal 45-day receivables; net of the LC drawing; cleared by settlement installments April 2024 to June 2025
offtaker_crisis.gas_netting_agreement: Tripartite netting SEKA-SNHK-project company signed 2023-06-29: up to USD 9.0m per month of SEKA energy-charge arrears set off against project company gas payables to SNHK

covenant_breach_and_waiver.principal_deferral: 60% of the 2023-12-31 scheduled principal deferred; repaid in four equal parts on 2024-06-30, 2024-12-31, 2025-06-30, 2025-12-31
covenant_breach_and_waiver.lock_up_release_condition: two consecutive historic DSCR tests >= 1.25x and DSRA fully replenished
covenant_breach_and_waiver.arrears_recovery_sweep: 100% of arrears recoveries applied to DSRA replenishment first

refinancing_2025.instrument: USD senior secured amortizing project bond, 144A/Reg S, listed
refinancing_2025.bond_amount_rule: = outstanding principal of prepaid tranches after the 2025-06-30 scheduled payment + transaction costs - swap unwind receipt; no upsizing
refinancing_2025.amortization: sculpted with remaining ECA and A-loan to combined base-case min DSCR 1.35x
refinancing_2025.bond_rating: B+ (one agency), sovereign B- at pricing
refinancing_2025.loan_breakage: none (settlement on an interest payment date)
refinancing_2025.intercreditor: bondholders accede through a bond trustee to the amended intercreditor agreement; ECA and A-loan consent to tenor extension of bond beyond 2034

partial_sale_2026.instruments_sold: pro rata shares and shareholder loans
partial_sale_2026.deferred_consideration_condition: SEKA overdue receivables remain zero through 2027-06-30
consents: senior lenders and bondholders (change of control threshold: Kilnworth >= 30% until 2030)
ROFR waivers by Groupe Talme and ABDB fund
partial_sale_2026.tax: Kessara indirect transfer tax 15% on seller gain

scenarios.FC_base: Sponsor and lenders' base case at financial close: COD 2021-05-01, 588.4 MW, base availability and dispatch, FC forward LIBOR curve, swap 80%, FX projection from 2018 via inflation differential using 2018 CPI expectations (Kessara 7.5%, US 2.2% flat).
scenarios.FC_banking: FC_base with banking dispatch 72.0%; identical to FC_base for capacity revenue
scenarios.actual_history: All events applied with historical macro paths through 2026H1 and assumptions after
sensitivities: SEKA payment delay 120 days for 12 months
breakevens: months of zero SEKA payment covered by DSRA plus LC
